description: Ask or describe an image on OpenVibe.Vision: POST /api/v1/ask and /api/v1/describe take an image (multipart, data URL or public URL), a question, a task (ask, describe, identify, count, translate, ocr) and a mode (auto, local, ai). A read question is answered by the local OCR reader first; everything else goes through OpenVibe.AI, whose provenance the answer reports. In auto mode a read question also works anonymously; any other task needs a signed-in person or this capability.
